runs.reason: Observed: ALT-4AF3D618FAA9 reports 17752 flows and 173643 packets in one minute from one source toward one destination port; subsequent alerts show recurring high volumes, including ALT-9941B48CD40E. FLOW-745C5543C223 and FLOW-8FC7C816EF4A show traffic from 172.16.0.1 to 192.168.10.50 on port 80. Inference: the sustained concentration is consistent with flooding, but service disruption and malicious intent are not established by flow evidence.

findings.observation: The initial DoS alert counts 17752 flows, 173643 packets, one source, and one destination port in one minute.
Retained flows show the same source and destination communicating on destination port 80 across successive alert minutes.

next_steps.reason: Assess whether the concentrated traffic caused service degradation or reflects authorized activity; this DoS category requires explicit analyst confirmation before closure.
